name: zindex_archive_open_create_write
description: zIndexArchive::OpenCreateWrite creates or truncates an index archive file for read/write access, stores the returned handle, and reports success for a valid handle.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a6270 validates CreateFileA(filepath, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, share none, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL), storing the HANDLE in zIndexArchive::hFile, and returning 1 only when the handle is not INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE.
The native archive flush/close smoke opens a temporary archive through OpenCreateWrite, writes an index footer via CloseAndFreeRecords, and reopens the file to validate the persisted footer.
